rubric_items.reason: REQ-1 to REQ-11 cover all five acceptance criteria. The parts the ticket does not ask for (walk-in booking, sorting by count, changes to the tile) are listed under Out of scope, each with a reason.
REQ-4 is now only the counting rule, so the a1 F-1 issue is fixed. REQ-6 and REQ-7 are split and testable. REQ-10 still joins filters and search in one REQ.
Every known REQ cites the ticket or the baseline. REQ-11 is assumed and has a real basis in ticket L16. The sum-equals-tile condition that was not in the ticket has been removed.
The ticket and baseline do not clash: both give Asia/Kolkata. A possible mismatch with the tile's rule is raised as Q-05, which cites the ticket and the glossary.
No question blocks and the roles fit. Q-05's default now follows the ticket, so a1 F-2 is fixed. Q-02 and Q-04 ask things the inputs already answer. Q-03's default is not one of its listed options.
Plain and readable, and glossary terms are used consistently. The unknowns and questions repeat each other a little, and some defaults are worded slightly differently from their options.
